error: Treesitter highlighter error - attempt to call method 'range' (a nil value) in languagetree.lua on markdown files
notes: Likely caused by markdown injection parsing. Try :TSInstall markdown markdown_inline. If unresolved check which injected language (code block) triggers it.

error: <A-q> does not kill the terminals properly on machines using tmux
notes: The dialog and the quit both work, but the terminal processes survive. Likely cause: the nvterm buffer runs zsh which attaches to a tmux client, so nvim_buf_delete(buf, {force=true}) in lua/custom/terminals.lua kills only the client - the tmux server and its session are a separate detached process tree that outlives nvim. Fix probably needs the session killed explicitly (tmux kill-session for the attached session) rather than relying on buffer deletion, or the terminals opened with a shell that does not attach. Check whether the tmux session is auto-attached from zshrc.
